items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context. The mention of Louis Armstrong ('Satchimo') is made by the Interviewer, who speculates that Armstrong 'used to play with him' (referring to Bunk Johnson). The interviewee does not confirm this or describe a personal relationship with Armstrong.

ctx.x: New York? I know you made a big hit in New York in 1945.
Oh, he was professional when he got to New York. He was professional. He was a big-timer. He really was a professional. He used to play. I think Satchimo used to play with him, too.
The other musicians say that. Yeah. That he learned from Bunk.
